evaluation.caveat: These confidence intervals cover inference stochasticity only (the random fire mask and the damage position). Each configuration was trained once, so training-seed variance is unmeasured and a filter or loss 'effect' may partly be training luck.

protocol.regen_rule: first update count k >= 1 after the damage with MSE <= max(1.1 * mse_pre, mse_pre + 1e-4), where mse_pre is the MSE just before damage; defined only if mse_pre <= converged_threshold
